mentions.name: FragForge
mentions.description: This site provides a database of optimal per-game graphics settings tuned to specific hardware, built by extracting settings from Twitch streamer clips and pairing them with each streamer's known hardware setup, with 200+ curated configs that go beyond generic "set everything to low" advice.
mentions.problem: Players burn significant time manually tweaking graphics settings like shadow quality and anti-aliasing to find the sweet spot between FPS and visual fidelity for their hardware.
mentions.audience: Gamers who want optimal per-game graphics settings tuned to their specific hardware instead of tweaking manually.
mentions.source_excerpt: I built FragForge (https://fragforge.app/) to scratch my own itch: one place to find optimal per-game settings tuned to specific hardware.
